boundary.preface: All characters before the first newline followed by Source:; no rstrip/reformat applied.
boundary.counting: Sum selected segment lengths; repeated selections outside the declared route, off-route probes, actual actor rereads and private context are excluded. Segment counts are not semantic hop counts.
